title: DG11--MKE Satellite Television Services    Base   4 Option Years
agency_path: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.252-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 12 (36C252)
detail_text: The Great Lakes Acquisition Center (GLAC) Milwaukee, WI is soliciting businesses for services to provide DirecTV Satellite TV Services at Clement J. Zablocki VA Medical Center in Milwaukee, WI. The contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, supplies, transportation, tools, materials, supervision, and other items and non-personal services necessary to provide DirecTV Satellite TV Services. This is a Presolicitation Notice only. See Contract Opportunities for 36C25226Q0376 solicitation document and submit quotes via that notice. POINT OF CONTACT: Richard Ruffin, richard.ruffin@va.gov Contracting Office Address: Great Lakes Acquisition Center (GLAC) Department of Veterans Affairs 115 S 84th Street, Suite 101 Milwaukee, WI Place of Performance: Clement J. Zablocki VA Medical Center Department of Veterans Affairs 5000 W. National Ave. Milwaukee, WI 53295-0001
